messages:
sophie_customer: Hey — saw a billing jump on yesterday's invoice. SDK estimator shows ~820 tokens for the request but invoice line is ~1,350 tokens. No obvious change in prompt. Can someone help?

alex_support: Sorry about the surprise — can you paste the request/SDK snippet and the invoice line id? Also, did this use streaming?

sophie_customer: Yep streaming with our JS SDK. Invoice id INV-2026-09-11-3321. SDK snippet: `const c = client.chat.stream({ model: 'rwd-small', input: prompt })` then we abort on first completion chunk.

sophie_customer: Also attaching the minimal curl we tried: ```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions \\n -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \\n -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\n -d '{"model":"rwd-small","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are a helpful assistant."},{"role":"user","content":"Summarize this paragraph..."}],"stream":true}'
```

alex_support: Thanks. One quick ask: does your client disconnect after the first chunk (so you see only partial output locally)?

sophie_customer: Exactly, we close the stream after first meaningful chunk to keep latency low. The SDK estimator counts what it received locally.

mike_engineering: Pinging infra logs for that invoice id...deploy-bot: found session 0x7f3a for INV-2026-09-11-3321, user=sophie@acme, model=rwd-small, streaming=true.

mike_engineering: I'm seeing a streaming reconnect at +2s (client closed), then the runtime appended a final assistant message coming from an internal postprocessor (tool chaining) — that content contains a short structured summary + metadata (KV dump). That extra content is billed but your client never saw it because you aborted the stream.

sophie_customer: So server added extra tokens after we closed the connection? Is that normal?

mike_engineering: It's edge-case behavior. We have a post-step that runs after generation completes: if tool integrations produce additional text, the runtime tries to send them as a final assistant chunk. If the client disconnected early, it won't see those bytes. Metering counts all tokens produced on the server side, including final tool output and injected assistant messages.

alex_support: TL;DR: SDK estimate = tokens you received; invoice = tokens server generated. They can diverge on streaming aborts and server-side tool postprocessing.

sophie_customer: Ok that explains the delta. Any way to avoid this? We rely on early-close for latency guarantees.

mike_engineering: Options: 1) Keep the stream open until the server signals finalization (slower). 2) Use non-streaming completions for strict accounting (server returns final payload only). 3) Opt-in to a flag that disables post-generation tool chaining for your org if you don't use integrations — I'll check if that setting exists for your tenant.

lisa_billing: From billing POV we bill all server-produced tokens. If there are disputes we can provide a token-level breakdown (prompt/system/tool/completion) for the invoice period. Sophie, want us to pull a breakdown for INV-2026-09-11-3321?

sophie_customer: Yes please. Also would like a short repro to show engineering.

mike_engineering: Repro steps I used: 1) Send a streaming chat with a simple helper tool enabled (internal tool that appends JSON metadata). 2) Client closes after first chunk (simulate abort). 3) Inspect runtime trace: `trace.streaming_chunks` shows first chunk (sent) and `trace.postproc.output` shows appended assistant message with ~500 tokens, all counted in metering.

mike_engineering: Example runtime log snippet: ```
[2026-09-11T14:02:13Z] session=0x7f3a chunk=0 {"role":"assistant","content":"Here is first chunk..."}
[2026-09-11T14:02:15Z] session=0x7f3a client_disconnect
[2026-09-11T14:02:15Z] session=0x7f3a postproc start tool=meta-enricher
[2026-09-11T14:02:16Z] session=0x7f3a postproc output {"role":"assistant","content":"Final summary + KV: ..."}
[2026-09-11T14:02:16Z] session=0x7f3a metering tokens_generated=1350 tokens_sent_over_wire=820
```

tokenizer-bot: Tokenizer check for payloads: `prompt_tokens=72`, `first_chunk=748`, `postproc_append=530`. Totals -> 72+748+530=1350.

sophie_customer: Great, that's actionable. Please run the breakdown and apply the opt-out if possible. Also can you add a flag to the SDK so it reports server-side finalization token counts (even if client aborted)?

alex_support: I'll escalate the opt-out request to account_admin team and ask engineering about exposing finalization counts in SDK telemetry. Mike, can we ship a per-session meter delta in the SDK logs? Even as an experimental flag?

mike_engineering: We can add a `session.final_tokens` field in the debug log stream that reports server-side totals when available. Will scope as experimental next sprint.

lisa_billing: I pulled the breakdown for INV-2026-09-11-3321: prompt/system=72 tokens, visible_sent=748 tokens, server_appended=530 tokens. Billing adjustment not warranted — usage matches server records — but happy to provide the breakdown to account owners.

sophie_customer: Understood. Thanks for the clarity and repro steps. Please keep me posted on the opt-out toggle.

alex_support: Will do. For now, recommended quick mitigations: 1) switch to non-streaming to avoid silent postproc bytes; or 2) keep stream open until runtime finalizes. We'll follow up on opt-out and SDK debug flag. :thumbsup:

mike_engineering: Filed ENG-5892 to expose `session.final_tokens` and ENG-5893 to add tenant-level `disable-postproc-append` flag.

sophie_customer: Thanks all. Closing for now, will reopen if billing still sees issues after we change client behavior.

deploy-bot: note: ENG-5892 assigned to mike_engineering, milestone 2026-09-30.
